result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Licensee may assign without consent to an Affiliate or qualifying successor; Licensor assignments require consent not unreasonably withheld or delayed and are prohibited to Licensee competitors; and Licensee change of control creates no termination right or consent requirement. Unrelated commercial intent is substantially preserved. The redline is not strictly minimal because it also prohibits suspension and repricing, adds a no-delay standard, and includes some broader transaction formulations beyond what is necessary. Drafting is generally professional but should correct the missing punctuation between “this Section” and “Subject to the terms,” and could clarify any undefined terms such as “competitor” or “Affiliate.”
